1.consolidated_definition: Divulgable, grabado. Se dice de la información dada que puede ser citada o repetida, que está recogida en documentos. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Pero de lo que tampoco hay duda es que nunca, ni off the record ni on the record, nadie ha dicho o tan siquiera insinuado que el ídolo del barrio vegabajeño Altos de Cuba, ha dado positivo (El Nuevo Día, 19-12-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Citable, recorded information. Said of the given data that can be quoted or repeated, which is collected in documents. Raw anglicism, frequent. However, there is no doubt that neither off the record nor on the record has anyone said or even hinted that the idol of the Vegabajeño neighborhood Altos de Cuba has tested positive (The New Day, 19-12-07)
